title: holidays signal
description: Public holidays (country JP only for now, from holidays-jp.github.io), refreshed daily. GET /api/signals/holidays, polled every hour; 404 unless providers.holidays.enabled (opt-in network); null until the first fetch. Not sensitive.

upcoming.description: The next 5 holidays from today (inclusive), in date order.

map.description: 'YYYY-MM-DD' -> holiday name, for about the 1st of last month .. +70 days (for calendar widgets).
